verdict.rationale: The evidence describes App Lock, Export Passwords and backup only as settings each user turns on in their own app. Admin involvement appears only as orgs requiring the Authenticator app itself or deciding whether notifications are allowed. Nothing shows an admin pushing org-wide in-app policies such as forced app lock, export restrictions or strong master-credential requirements.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
